# Goal
Mado round 14. L1 canonical planner. C1 coverage lowest nonretired 5.7143/10: sourced U5 output-management/colour boundaries, U1–U4 4/7 -> U1–U5 5/7, no feature exercise. C2 operability: source resolver must refuse directory-shaped direct and glob targets with stable owning-row diagnostics; current exact set and order behavior retained. Add isolated source-order negative fixture but do not claim its already-working behavior as improvement. Address outside R13-V1 retained-data wording, R13-V2 within-run boundary versus revision-output equality, R13-V3 standalone receipt measured digest.
# Contract
Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin; every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/<that path>. Every seat leaf, no delegation, no background jobs, no commits/push. Host configs, sibling/fleet source read-only. No compositor mutations, protocol feature requests, raw session logs/titles, device/output identities. Skip builds/lint/tests/formatters/smoke mid-flight; L1 runs once after seats finish. Only GateImplement edits tools/mado-verify.sh; others own explicit new artifact/report paths. Source opens include canonical URL, pinned revision, date, <=25-word located quote, tier scope, admit/reject + flip. Do not invent counts/outputs. Authoring review is not non-author promotion authority. Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read `/home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md` first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in the report).
